claim: ProvisionedPollerConfig sets the minimum (2-200) and maximum (2-2000) dedicated event pollers for an SQS event source mapping; each poller handles up to 1 MB/sec and 10 concurrent invokes.
question: What are the ranges for provisioned pollers on an SQS event source mapping?

values.display: 1 MB/sec of throughput and 10 concurrent invokes
